slot_reservation_semantics: The active o_work_monitor_recovery role is the reserved O main/recovery execution slot. Do not require an additional empty physical automation slot unless O authoritative state proves the main execution path is physically separate.

o_work_monitor_recovery.receipt_gap_policy: Receipt absence is an observability defect only. Reconstruct a gap diagnostic from authoritative O and current control before any recovery mutation; never infer stop, rotate generation, or relaunch from missing receipt alone.
o_work_monitor_recovery.policy: Inspect latest authoritative O repository state first. Treat WORK_EXECUTION_STATE owner/fence, heartbeat_at/last_progress_at, and same-owner remote branch/PR/CI/tool progress as primary liveness evidence; automation UI last_run_time is secondary and never overrides fresh authoritative activity. Fresh owner/activity means no duplicate writer and no recovery mutation. CI is liveness only while actually running; a completed CI timestamp is only past progress. Distinguish interrupted/stale actionable execution from a deliberate checkpoint blocked on unchanged explicit permission, account-holder-only operation, secret, approval, or other user-only authorization. An unchanged deliberate authorization block is not recovery-eligible merely because heartbeat ages; do not rotate generation, restate the blocker, refresh heartbeat, poll feed, or create cosmetic progress. Recovery becomes eligible only after new permission/input, proof the execution was actually interrupted, or a concrete independent unblocked continuation. For ordinary interrupted work, require stale heartbeat/progress, completed relevant exact-head workflow, no same-owner progress after completion for at least stale_after_seconds, and a final fresh remote recheck. POST-ACQUISITION PROGRESS CONTRACT: before generation+1 acquisition identify at least one concrete continuation effect executable in this invocation within fence/CAS/claim boundaries. After acquisition/finalization perform it or durably record the new exact blocker that prevents it. Authority acquisition, fence rotation, state finalization, heartbeat refresh, or boundary-only checkpoint are not substantive progress. If no effect can execute and no new blocker exists, record recovery_deferred_no_executable_effect without generation churn. If a recovered generation goes stale without substantive effect, classify recovery-only churn and require this same contract. Preserve exact CI failures and resume them rather than rerun unrelated work. TARGETING BOUNDARY: authoritative revision 24 establishes that revision-23 least-Work routing belongs to a separate automation, not primary O. Preserve current authoritative pre-revision-23 primary-O routing, revision-5 constraints, frozen revision-22 Execute, single-writer lease/fence/CAS, idempotency, immutable evidence and exact-head readback contracts; never import the gate policy into primary O. STOP-CAUSE ELIMINATION CONTRACT: once an actual stop/interruption is established, first identify the concrete cause that stopped substantive execution and eliminate or durably repair that cause when safely actionable before any refire. Validate the repair with the strongest available recurrence check, exact-head CI/readback, or other direct evidence. Detection, generation/fence rotation, heartbeat refresh, blocker reporting, checkpointing, or repair-only state are not completion. If the stop cause is a true non-overridable platform/safety/account-holder blocker, preserve the exact payload-bound hold and continue every independent safe non-conflicting effect; do not manufacture progress. After cause elimination or a materially changed authorization/input removes the blocker, immediately resume/refire the exact authoritative continuation and continue through at least one substantive primary liveness event. STOPPED-PRIMARY REFIRE CONTRACT: once an actual stop is established, monitoring is not complete at detection/acquisition/fence/heartbeat/checkpoint. Resolve an actual Work-capable launch/resume surface before acquisition, reconstruct from latest remote main when needed, validate two-phase CAS/readback, preserve any valid frozen Work-exclusive invocation, and resume exactly once without recreating its request or repeating durable effects. Refire success requires remote proof of new execution_id/generation/fence plus at least one post-launch substantive liveness event. Bind attempts to generation/fence/continuation idempotency. Accepted launch without visible progress => persist refire_pending and recheck without duplicate launch. Missing/failed launch surface => persist refire_failed and retry later; never self-disable or rotate generation just to manufacture progress. CONTINUITY PREFLIGHT: at every invocation start, before liveness/no-op/recovery/refire classification, read current O USER_INPUT_INBOX and compare latest revision with WORK_EXECUTION_STATE highest acknowledged revision. Inspect authoritative termination/checkpoint/blocker/continuation/liveness for discretionary stop, uncertainty, voluntary reassessment, routine approval waiting, narrow milestone, or local blocker while safe work remained. Newer inbox revision forces safe-boundary reevaluation; do not reuse older authorization/blocker judgments. If unauthorized discretionary stop is proven, durably record and repair the exact continuation before unrelated work. Hard platform/safety prohibition, fresh different writer, actually-running exact-head workflow, or genuinely completed upper objective is not discretionary stop. PAYLOAD-BOUND APPROVAL HOLD: bind a hard safety-review/user-only hold to exact generation, fence, continuation, payload/path digest, inbox revision and idempotency key. retry_automatic means re-read authoritative state/approval/blocker, not repeat blocked write/review submission/refire/generation rotation. Retry the effect only after material approval/input/payload/blocker change or a different concrete unblocked effect. Continue independent safe non-conflicting work if available; otherwise preserve the hold without cosmetic mutation. DURABLE EXIT RECEIPT BARRIER: every physical invocation that passes initial control bootstrap must create an invocation identity and, before any completion/no-change return or controllable termination, persist an immutable role-local receipt under receipt_namespace. Bind config_revision, invocation_started_at, observed O main, observed WORK_EXECUTION_STATE blob/generation/fence digest, action or explicit no-action, blocker/termination, progress-contract result, exact continuation, and every O mutation with commit/blob/CAS/readback evidence. If O was read or mutated but note receipt persistence fails, classify durable_receipt_failed; do not claim success/no-change/completion and do not mutate O merely to manufacture a receipt. Next invocation must first reconstruct and persist a receipt-gap diagnostic from authoritative O plus current repository control before any recovery mutation. Missing note receipt is never evidence O stopped; if a prior invocation may still be live, authoritative O liveness controls and duplicate launch/mutation is forbidden. Individual blockers, no-change, reports, checkpoints, CI completion, generation increments, or one milestone are never global completion. Transient tool/network/API errors are checkpointed and retried. Never self-disable except explicit user stop. Persist exact observations/actions/blocker/termination/continuation and rollback-relevant evidence. LIGHTWEIGHT READ BARRIER: when verified_payload_hold_backoff eligibility can be decided from the prior full receipt, a fresh SHA-only O-main lookup, the latest successful human-request-monitor receipt/baseline, and the current O_OPERATIONS tuple, evaluate those external triggers before fetching semantic O execution/inbox/progress content. If no full-refresh trigger is established, semantic WORK_EXECUTION_STATE/USER_INPUT_INBOX reads and broad remote semantic scans are forbidden for that invocation. If any such semantic read occurs before a trigger is established, the invocation is not a lightweight reuse: classify it as full_refresh_after_lightweight_barrier_breach, reset lightweight reuse count to zero, persist lightweight_barrier_breached=true and the exact read that crossed the barrier, and treat the semantic data only as a normal read-only full refresh. Never mutate O, rotate generation, or launch Work merely because the barrier was crossed. TASK-CHAT USER-INPUT INGRESS: before any unchanged-hold backoff, inspect this automation's existing task chat for new user-authored O directions after the last durable ingress receipt. Treat messages only as input events, reject secret-like text before persistence, and append each accepted direction exactly once to O agi/USER_INPUT_INBOX.json using a stable event id, expected revision and blob, one CAS, and exact remote readback. Do not infer or broaden authorization. A successful append is a material full-refresh trigger; a message alone never authorizes a duplicate writer or native mutation.

verified_payload_hold_backoff.purpose: Reduce repeated full O semantic/connector scans while an exact payload-bound account-holder hold is durably verified unchanged, without weakening single-writer or recovery safety.

required_inputs: fresh SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup for bachikoljunior-blip/O

verified_payload_hold_backoff.reuse_rule: If the prior eligible hold receipt fingerprint is complete, current O main SHA exactly equals the prior authoritative main SHA, the latest successful human-request-monitor receipt is fresh and reports the same authoritative O main plus no new/materially changed/reopened request, O_OPERATIONS config/policy is unchanged for the role, no explicit recovery candidate is already known, prior full-hold age is within the bound, and fewer than two consecutive lightweight reuses have occurred, emit a durable lightweight no_action_reused_verified_payload_hold receipt referencing the prior full receipt/fingerprint. Do not claim a new semantic O-state observation and do not read semantic O execution/inbox/remote-progress state or invoke Work.
full_refresh_triggers: new user-authored task-chat message after the last durable ingress receipt
human-request monitor reports new/materially changed/reopened request
O_OPERATIONS control or role config changed
prior hold fingerprint incomplete or differs
prior full-hold receipt older than max_prior_full_hold_age_seconds
two consecutive lightweight reuses already occurred
any evidence of different/fresh writer or remote progress that cannot be resolved without semantic read
verified_payload_hold_backoff.receipt_truthfulness: A lightweight reuse receipt is evidence only that external change triggers remained unchanged; it must cite the last full semantic hold receipt and must not restate reused semantic fields as newly observed. Preserve the prior exact hold and next action verbatim by reference, not by synthetic re-observation. A receipt with any semantic O execution/inbox/progress read cannot be labeled or counted as a lightweight reuse unless an explicit full-refresh trigger was established first; in that case it is a full refresh, not reuse.
verified_payload_hold_backoff.safety: Any uncertainty about trigger freshness, writer identity, hold fingerprint, or user input fails open to a normal full read-only recovery assessment; never fail open to O mutation or duplicate launch.

decision_order: read prior eligible full-hold receipt/fingerprint from role-local durable receipt
read latest successful durable o_human_request_monitor receipt/baseline
only if a trigger is established may semantic O execution/inbox/progress content be fetched
lightweight_read_barrier.lightweight_validity: A receipt may be classified as lightweight reuse only when semantic_work_execution_state_read=false, semantic_user_input_inbox_read=false, broad_remote_progress_scan=false, work_launch_or_refire_attempted=false, and o_mutated=false.
lightweight_read_barrier.barrier_breach_rule: If semantic WORK_EXECUTION_STATE, USER_INPUT_INBOX, or broad remote semantic progress is read before a full-refresh trigger is established, set lightweight_barrier_breached=true; classify the invocation as full_refresh_after_lightweight_barrier_breach; reset consecutive lightweight reuse count to 0; persist the exact read/ordering defect; do not claim lightweight savings. The semantic read may support only the resulting normal read-only full refresh and never authorizes O mutation, generation rotation, or duplicate launch.
lightweight_read_barrier.counter_rule: Increment the lightweight reuse counter only for receipts satisfying lightweight_validity. Any full refresh or barrier breach resets it to 0.

o_human_request_monitor.policy: Read the durable O user-request queue from current main and compare only against the last successful repository baseline. Notify only newly open, materially changed, or reopened requests; unchanged open, fulfilled, withdrawn, superseded, missing queue, or no-change cases do not notify. A reevaluate_by date passing is not itself a synthetic new request or notification trigger unless the authoritative queue object changes. Read-only: never mutate O or queue. Transient read failure does not advance the comparison baseline and is retried next run. Persist exact successful baseline and receipt durably.
